doc: Element reactions. elements are sorted in canonical element order; lookups are order-independent. hooks/statuses are semantic; each game decides numbers.

reactions.name: Extinguish
reactions.description: Water snuffs the fire in a hissing burst of white vapour; burning targets are put out.

reactions.name: Steam Cloud
reactions.description: Fire flash-melts ice into a scalding cloud that blinds anyone inside.

reactions.name: Plasma Burst
reactions.description: Superheated plasma detonates and punches through armour.

reactions.name: Magma Pool
reactions.description: The ground melts into a bubbling pool of lava.

reactions.name: Firestorm
reactions.description: Wind whips the flames into a roaring, wandering fire tornado.

reactions.name: Wildfire
reactions.description: Fire catches on every plant and spreads from target to target.

reactions.name: Solar Flare
reactions.description: A miniature sun erupts, scorching and dazzling everything nearby.

reactions.name: Shadowflame
reactions.description: Black fire that slips past shields and clings to its victim.

reactions.name: Gas Explosion
reactions.description: Toxic gas meets a spark. Everything nearby is launched.

reactions.name: Molten Slag
reactions.description: Armour glows red, softens and drips; defences melt away.

reactions.name: Spellfire
reactions.description: Enchanted flames mark targets; every hit on a marked foe burns brighter.

reactions.name: Electrocute
reactions.description: Lightning races through the water and arcs between every wet target.

reactions.name: Flash Freeze
reactions.description: Soaked targets freeze solid in an instant.

reactions.name: Mudslide
reactions.description: A churning river of mud sweeps everything downhill.

reactions.name: Typhoon
reactions.description: Sideways rain and screaming wind shove enemies back.

reactions.name: Bloom
reactions.description: Watered seeds burst into a garden that heals allies and tangles foes.

reactions.name: Abyss
reactions.description: Black water opens a whirlpool that drags victims into the dark.

reactions.name: Contamination
reactions.description: Toxins spread through the water; every wet target is poisoned.

reactions.name: Rust
reactions.description: Water rusts metal on contact: armour flakes off and joints seize.

reactions.name: Rainbow
reactions.description: Sunlight through spray: a rainbow arc speeds allies, and enemies stop to stare.

reactions.name: Mana Spring
reactions.description: A glowing spring bubbles up, healing and cleansing allies who stand in it.

reactions.name: Superconductor
reactions.description: Supercooled lightning arcs further and cracks armour.

reactions.name: Permafrost
reactions.description: The ground freezes solid; feet stick to it.

reactions.name: Blizzard
reactions.description: A howling snowstorm freezes and blinds everything inside.

reactions.name: Frostbloom
reactions.description: Thorny vines of ice erupt from the ground and pin enemies.

reactions.name: Prism
reactions.description: A crystal prism splits light into a fan of rainbow beams.

reactions.name: Black Ice
reactions.description: An invisible sheet of dark ice. Enemies slip, slide and fall.

reactions.name: Cryotoxin
reactions.description: Frozen venom that lasts twice as long and slows the blood.

reactions.name: Shatter
reactions.description: Frozen metal turns brittle and explodes into razor shards.

reactions.name: Stasis
reactions.description: Time itself freezes around the target.

reactions.name: Fulgurite
reactions.description: Lightning fuses sand to glass; jagged glass spikes burst out.

reactions.name: Thunderstorm
reactions.description: A dark storm cloud rolls in and strikes at random.

reactions.name: Sparkbloom
reactions.description: Charged pollen pops in a crackling chain.

reactions.name: Flashbang
reactions.description: A blinding flash and a deafening crack.

reactions.name: Black Lightning
reactions.description: Dark lightning ignores shields and jumps between foes.

reactions.name: Neurotoxin
reactions.description: Electric venom locks up muscles in twitching jolts.

reactions.name: Magnetic Storm
reactions.description: Raw magnetism rips metal objects into the air and fries them.

reactions.name: Leyline Surge
reactions.description: Lightning rides the ley lines and arcs to every marked enemy.

reactions.name: Sandstorm
reactions.description: Stinging sand blots out the sky.

reactions.name: Thornwall
reactions.description: A wall of thorny roots heaves out of the ground.

reactions.name: Crystallize
reactions.description: Glowing crystals grow over allies like armour.

reactions.name: Sinkhole
reactions.description: The ground opens into a dark pit that swallows the unwary.

reactions.name: Blight
reactions.description: The soil turns toxic and rotten; nothing stands on it for long.

reactions.name: Iron Spikes
reactions.description: Iron spikes burst up from the ground like a bed of nails.

reactions.name: Runequake
reactions.description: Runes crack the ground and a stone golem pulls itself out.

reactions.name: Pollen Storm
reactions.description: A golden swirl of pollen leaves enemies dizzy and dreamy.

reactions.name: Aurora
reactions.description: Ribbons of shimmering light quicken and heal allies.

reactions.name: Nightwind
reactions.description: A dark breeze hides allies and confuses enemy sight.

reactions.name: Toxic Cloud
reactions.description: Wind carries a sickly green cloud across the battlefield.

reactions.name: Bladestorm
reactions.description: A whirlwind full of spinning steel blades.

reactions.name: Warp Gale
reactions.description: A gust folds space and throws enemies somewhere else.

reactions.name: Sunbloom
reactions.description: Flowers open in the sunlight and heal everyone nearby.

reactions.name: Wither
reactions.description: Life is drained out of the target and into the caster.

reactions.name: Spore Burst
reactions.description: Giant mushrooms burst and fill the air with dizzy spores.

reactions.name: Ironbark
reactions.description: Steel-hard bark grows over allies and walls.

reactions.name: Fey Ring
reactions.description: A ring of glowing mushrooms charms anyone who steps inside.

reactions.name: Eclipse
reactions.description: Light and shadow collide: the sky goes dark with a burning ring.

reactions.name: Purify
reactions.description: A cleansing flash burns toxins away and heals allies.

reactions.name: Mirror Shield
reactions.description: A mirrored barrier bounces projectiles back at their source.

reactions.name: Starfall
reactions.description: Shooting stars rain from the sky onto the target area.

reactions.name: Plague
reactions.description: A creeping curse that jumps from victim to victim.

reactions.name: Phantom Blades
reactions.description: Ghostly swords slice through walls and shields.

reactions.name: Void
reactions.description: A black hole tears open and drags everything into it.

reactions.name: Corrosion
reactions.description: Acid eats through armour and machinery.

reactions.name: Hex
reactions.description: A green curse that saps strength and scrambles spells.

reactions.name: Enchanted Steel
reactions.description: Runes flare along every weapon: hits deal extra damage and flying blades guard you.

reactions.name: Inferno
reactions.description: Fire on fire: a towering blaze that engulfs the whole area.

reactions.name: Tsunami
reactions.description: A wall of water crashes down and sweeps the field clean.

reactions.name: Absolute Zero
reactions.description: Cold beyond cold; everything nearby freezes in place.

reactions.name: Overcharge
reactions.description: Stacked charge discharges in a branching storm of bolts.

reactions.name: Earthquake
reactions.description: The ground splits open and heaves enemies into the air.

reactions.name: Tornado
reactions.description: Wind stacks into a full tornado that lifts and flings everything.

reactions.name: Overgrowth
reactions.description: The battlefield bursts into jungle: roots grab enemies and allies regrow.

reactions.name: Supernova
reactions.description: Light collapses into a star and explodes in a white-hot nova.

reactions.name: Blackout
reactions.description: All light dies. Enemies stumble in total darkness.

reactions.name: Pandemic
reactions.description: Stacked toxins become a plague that spreads on its own.

reactions.name: Fortress
reactions.description: Steel plates slam together into a fortified bastion.

reactions.name: Arcane Overload
reactions.description: Too much magic in one place. It detonates in a storm of runes.
